findings.name: Disable or Modify Windows Event Log
findings.behavior: pedro-admin account disabled Windows process creation command-line logging by setting ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled registry value to 0 via reg.exe.

findings.name: Log Enumeration
findings.behavior: PowerShell scripts queried Security and Application event logs with time-based filters to harvest or analyze logged events.
